article_limitations: Disposition aggregate_only: the source reports 31 consecutive intraoperative iatrogenic aortic dissection cases only as a cohort (percentages, means, medians in text and Tables 1-5); no patient has individual identity evidence or an individually described course, so no individual patient records are created and cohort statistics are not copied to placeholder patients.
reported_individual_count is 31 (literal) and roster_complete is false because none of the 31 stated individuals can be enumerated.
The source lists no figures and no supplements; the article contains Tables 1-5 (all present in source.json) and the text cites Tables 1-5.
Table 5 compares the cohort with published series from other centers; those are literature data, not patients of this article.
